def bell_number(n):
    # Bell numbers count the number of partitions of a set of n elements.
    # Use the Bell triangle (Aitken's array) to compute B_n.
    if n < 0:
        raise ValueError("n must be non-negative")
    if n == 0:
        return 1

    # Start with the first row: [1]
    row = [1]
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        # Next row starts with the last element of the previous row
        new_row = [row[-1]]
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            new_row.append(new_row[-1] + row[j - 1])
        row = new_row

    return row[0]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert bell_number(0) == 1
    assert bell_number(1) == 1
    assert bell_number(2) == 2
    assert bell_number(3) == 5
    assert bell_number(4) == 15
    assert bell_number(5) == 52
    print("All tests passed")
